patterns.note: Asymmetrical, whimsical black-and-white illustrations are paired with structured text blocks and full-width content sections, creating a dynamic yet organized page flow.
Section titles utilize a very bold, outlined, display-style sans-serif font, providing a playful and distinctive character, contrasted with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A predominantly monochrome (black and off-white) base is accented with a limited palette of muted purples, browns, and pinks, primarily within the illustrations.
The header, containing the logo, navigation, and social links, remains sticky at the top of the viewport during initial scrolling, eventually scrolling out of view at deeper page depths.
Content sections, including large illustrations and a video player, reveal sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, without complex scroll-triggered animations.
Large, full-width illustrative sections serve as visual anchors and introductions to subsequent content blocks, often featuring a hand-drawn, playful aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport during scrolling, then scrolls off-screen as the user reaches the bottom of the page, allowing full content immersion.

Content sections are revealed through standard browser scrolling, with no complex scroll-triggered animations such as parallax, fade-ins, or slide-ups; the design relies on static visual hierarchy and the inherent motion of a video hero.

A video hero element is prominently integrated into a content section, featuring a large 'PLAY' button, indicating on-demand video playback rather than an auto-playing or scroll-controlled background video.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, outlined display headings (~4-5x body text) for section titles, paired with a clear, readable sans-serif for body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are applied consistently to interactive elements like buttons, cards, and the cookie banner, maintaining a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with airy, full-width hero and video sections featuring large illustrations, contrasted with a more compact grid layout for blog post cards.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extensive use of whimsical, black-and-white line-art illustrations with selective, muted color accents. These illustrations are integrated throughout the page, creating a strong, playful, and highly personalized brand identity that feels like a digital sketchbook, making the portfolio itself a work of art.
